why: I keep the bee: one collar, one flower and one line say the most with the least, and it flies off before it overstays.

veto.quote: verbosity; the obvious; decoration without meaning
veto.why: An alternate icon is decoration with nothing to do, the most obvious place a pet could be put.

style: Each pet is small, quiet and carries one object, drawn in few strokes with no ornament beyond its purpose.
making: The worry: nineteen separate drawings may each grow chatty; the style sheet must hold every pet to few strokes and one object.
